bagPolicy.summary: The Blue Cross Arena will implement a Clear Bag Policy effective January 5, 2026, allowing only clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags no larger than 12” x 6” x 12” and small clutch purses. Metal detector screening will be conducted at entrances.
allowed: clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags no larger than 12” x 6” x 12”
small clutch purse no larger than 4.5" x 6.5"
prohibited: metal or hard plastic beverage containers
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags are allowed if the child is present. Exceptions for credentialed staff, approved media, and medically necessary items after inspection.

parking.note: Several parking options are available near Blue Cross Arena, with varying walking distances. The Civic Center Garage is conveniently connected via an underground tunnel. Pricing details are not provided on the website.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Blue Cross Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Blue Cross Arena does not allow outside food, beverages, or alcohol. Specific food and drink options available inside the venue are not detailed on the provided page.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Blue Cross Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted once you have exited the arena.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Blue Cross Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Blue Cross Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
